counterfactual_missing_items: Coronary computed tomography angiography showed no abnormalities
No ischemic or memory T waves in pre- and post-exercise ECGs
The baseline 12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) showed no substantial abnormalities.
decisive_items: left bundle-branch block (LBBB) in stage 2 at heart rate of 107 beats per minute with chest pain
LBBB resolved following exercise cessation with immediate angina relief
response.rationale: R1 captures the full clinical sequence including the transient LBBB during exercise and its resolution, which are key diagnostic features for Cardiac Syndrome X. C1 only notes exertional chest pain, missing the crucial ECG findings that R1 includes.
